dbSNP4Bioc 0.1.0

Convert one dbSNP chromosome to Parquet and cache it

Source: R/build.R
dbsnp_build_chrom.Rd

Extracts a single chromosome from the dbSNP VCF named by dbsnp_gcf_path() (or the vcf argument), keeps SNV records only, writes two sorted Parquet tables (by_pos, by_rsid), and stores them plus an updated manifest.json in a BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache() cache. Later calls to dbsnp_tbl() read straight from this cache.

Usage

dbsnp_build_chrom(
  chrom,
  release = "b157",
  build = "GRCh38",
  vcf = dbsnp_gcf_path(),
  cache = dbsnp_cache(),
  tabix = "tabix",
  rg_pos = 122880L,
  rg_rsid = 16384L,
  threads = NULL,
  memory_limit = NULL,
  tmpdir = tempfile("dbsnp4bioc_build_")
)

Arguments

chrom

Chromosome to build: "1"-"22", "X", or "Y".

release

dbSNP release label, used only to namespace the cache (e.g. "b157").

build

Genome build label, used only to namespace the cache (e.g. "GRCh38").

vcf

Path to the bgzipped, tabix-indexed dbSNP VCF. Defaults to dbsnp_gcf_path(), i.e. the DBSNP_GCF_PATH environment variable.

cache

A BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache() object; defaults to dbsnp_cache().

tabix

Name or path of the tabix executable.

rg_pos, rg_rsid

Parquet row-group sizes for the by_pos and by_rsid tables; smaller row groups let zone maps prune more.

threads, memory_limit

Optional duckdb SET threads / SET memory_limit values.

tmpdir

Scratch directory for the intermediate TSV and Parquet files before they are copied into the cache.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame with columns chrom, table, path describing the newly cached files (as returned by dbsnp_cached()).
